description: Source code for the MovieLensALS example application in Apache Spark's MLlib, demonstrating collaborative filtering using ALS on MovieLens dataset.

classes.name: Params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the MovieLensALS application, including input path, number of iterations, lambda, rank, and flags for Kryo serialization and implicit preferences.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application; parses command-line arguments and initiates the run process.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up Spark context, loads data, trains ALS model, evaluates RMSE, and stops Spark context.

methods.name: computeRmse
methods.description: Calculates Root Mean Squared Error for the model predictions against test data.
